SELECT
	ACID
	,BEGIN_CHQ_NUM
	,REC_TYPE
	,SP_SRL_NUM
	,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
	,DEL_FLG
	,PAYEE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(ACPT_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS ACPT_DATE
	,END_CHQ_NUM
	,CHQ_ALPHA
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(CHQ_DATE, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS CHQ_DATE
	,CHQ_AMT
	,ACPT_AUTH_ID
	,ACCT_BAL
	,SP_REASON_CODE
	,RCRE_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(RCRE_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS RCRE_TIME
	,LCHG_USER_ID
	,CONVERT(DATETIME2, STUFF(STUFF(STUFF(LCHG_TIME, 9, 0, ' '), 12, 0, ':'), 15, 0, ':')) AS LCHG_TIME
	,TS_CNT
	,PRINT_ADVICE
	,PRINT_STATUS
	,BANK_ID
	,CHQ_NUM_ENTERED
	,1 AS ISACTIVE
	,1 AS ISLATEST
	,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS BNK_CODE
	,SUBSTRING(FILE_NAME,7,3) AS SOURCE_CODE
	,FILE_NAME
	,CONVERT(DATE,[INSERT_DTTM]) AS INSERT_DTTM
 FROM d360.STG_DEP_STOPPAYMENTREGTABLE
